note: Maps each in-scope surface row of the docs/shakedown.md coverage appendix to the harness case ids that exercise it (or an explicit non-case disposition). The scorecard cross-checks this against the executed cases: a surface with no executed mapped case and no disposition is 'uncovered' and fails the scorecard, even when every case that ran was green. Keys are the appendix surface slugs (shakedown-scorecard.mjs derives them live from docs/shakedown.md). Maintained per sprint alongside case authoring (epic 65rk: .3 authors S10 cases, .6 the capability matrix, .9 refreshes the appendix). disposition is one of null | "manual" | "partner" | "waived"; a non-null disposition should carry an operator and reason.
